verdict.rationale:
Jev is fundamentally an API/SDK product—Python and JS SDKs, async clients, programmatic model listing (GET /v1/models), and automatic retry/backoff handling are all documented, meaning it can run entirely headlessly without any UI. Community evidence corroborates real automated usage (e.g., wiring Jev into a game loop via OpenRouter API calls in real time).

missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or docs, no dedicated 'headless automation' or CI guide, no mention of service-account/API-key patterns for scripted environments.
